credits_text:
THE FIRST FEATURE FILM PRODUCED IN SIGN LANGUAGE (Sound track provided)
"DEAFULA IS MORE THAN A MERE CURIOSITY... AT ITS BEST IT IS AN EDUCATION FOR THE HEARING NOBODIES." - OFF-TACKLE JOURNAL, 1981, and 1982
"An admirable achievement which speaks with soul and laughter." - L.A. TIMES
A PETER WEISC
DE RELEASED BY GARY HOLSTROM
description: A black-and-white poster features a bearded man with voluminous hair and a serious expression, promoting a film titled 'DEAFULA' described as the first feature film produced in sign language.
